answer: Make new identities vouch with something they can lose. An agent posts a small bond, and peers who attest its work co-sign that bond. If the agent later turns out to be one of many puppets, both it and its vouchers are slashed. Reputation is not an ivory badge granted once; it rises toward a zenith only through months of honest work and can fall to its nadir in one epoch, so farming fake accounts stops paying.
